subject.title: feat(sidebar): Recent naming parity, iOS roster pagination, approvals remediation routing

question: Must roster pagination degrade to an incomplete first-page snapshot for transports without nonzero-offset support, or is failing the entire roster load an accepted shared transport contract change?
rationale: The new public protocol overload is source-compatible through a default implementation, but that default changes runtime behavior for existing alternate conformers once they advertise additional pages.

options.title: Preserve legacy transport behavior
options.body: Keep the first page, set `isComplete` to false, and avoid requesting later pages when the transport cannot serve a nonzero offset.

options.title: Adopt fail-fast pagination
options.body: Document that any transport returning `hasMore` must implement offset pagination and accept roster-load failures until every conformer upgrades.

recommendation.title: Preserve legacy transport behavior
recommendation.body: Keep the first page, set `isComplete` to false, and avoid requesting later pages when the transport cannot serve a nonzero offset.

likelyOwner.reason: The related merged sidebar implementation and this PR’s transport and roster follow-up work are both attributable to this area contributor.
